{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Well, I see that time is running out, so we had better turn our attention to the assembly of the impulse-to-voice translator: the impulse-to-voice translator, the very heart of the mini-transmitter, which converts electronic energy, which ''you'' provide, into any of a thousand recognizable languages.|[[Dromboid]], hosting an instruction cassette|<ref name="The Star Wars Holiday Special">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref>}}
The '''impulse-to-voice translator''' was a component in the construction of [[mini-transmitter]]s, devices that converted speech into other [[Language/Legends|languages]]. One [[Unidentified Amorphiian company|Amorphiian company]] sold a brand of mini-transmitter during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that included an impulse-to-voice translator.
